brief.question: The person asked for 'a website for my bakery' and added 'make an order system'. There is no original target: rebuild the established four-page warm artisan placeholder site (Home, Menu, Our Story, Visit) in Vite + React + TypeScript, and add a working order/cart/checkout flow.
brief.purpose: Deliver the requested bakery website with a usable order system as a static build under app/dist.
constraints: No original target - the earlier plain-JS build is the only design reference
Neutral placeholder brand 'Hearth & Crumb' and original line-art icons, no copied logos/photos
Static build with relative base './' ; no dev servers or watchers started by hand
Branding/style choices remain open with the person
brief.done_when: npm run build succeeds, the four original pages plus a new order page render as static files, the cart persists and checkout confirms an order, and rebuild_check results are reported with any limits.

plan.title: Rebuild the four pages in React + TypeScript
plan.why: Home, Menu, Our Story and Visit keep the warm artisan look.

findings.statement: The four original pages were rebuilt in Vite + React + TypeScript and a new Order page was added. npm run build passes and app/dist contains index, menu, about, visit and order HTML plus shared CSS/JS assets, with base './' so it works as static files.

The order system works end to end in a scripted browser run: an item added on the menu appears in the basket with the correct total, checkout details can be filled in, and placing the order shows a numbered confirmation ('Order HC-…', 'Thank you, Test Customer'). Cart state persists in local storage and the basket badge updates. The check passed with no page errors.

handoff: This turn confirmed the existing Vite + React + TypeScript bakery site still builds (npm run build = tsc -b && vite build passed; five HTML pages in app/dist) and answered the new request 'show me how to publish this site' by writing app/HOW-TO-PUBLISH.md: a plain-English guide whose main path is dragging the dist folder onto https://app.netlify.com/drop, with GitHub Pages/Vercel as alternatives, a reminder to replace the placeholder name/address/phone/email, and a note that orders are only confirmed on screen (no email delivery, no online payment). rebuild_check: 'build: passed'; no visual comparison possible because there is no original target. The three open unknowns (real brand name unk_753a122cc72f977f, visual style/content unk_ab833bb9e2ac0722, order scope unk_9fa30d5afcc67a29) are person-preference questions that no further evidence look can settle; they remain open and were raised in the guide and the final summary. Traps: keep only vite.config.ts (an old vite.config.js once shadowed it); base './' makes the site work on any static host including subdirectories. Never start dev servers by hand. Next useful step: ask the person for their real bakery details and whether they want emailed orders or online payment.
